member.summary: Provides UI and project management services for an update action.

remarks.para:
An can provide the following for an :
A custom editor.
Validation that is performed before an update is built.
Pre- and post-build actions that can extend the capabilities of an action by, for example, copying files to be included in an update.
Initialization after creation or loading.
Customizion of the action's appearance to the user.

To create a custom , inherit from this class and provide a public parameterless constructor. To link an to an , provide an on the , specifying the type of the . If the type specified in the cannot be found, does not inherit from , or does not have a public, parameterless constructor, the default will be used instead.
To specify a custom editor, override the method and use the provided to to present your custom editor. Note that any custom action editor must ensure that and are called as needed.
To provide validation for an action, override and add any validation errors to the provided collection.
To provide initialization, override to initialize newly created actions and to initialize loaded actions.
To customize the action's appearance, set the and properties.
